edits.current: SHARP CONTRAST WITH FORM 350. The instruction guide says this number is 'asignado por la natural person o juridica que expide la certificacion' - the EMPLOYER assigns it, not DIAN. On Form 350 casilla 4 is DIAN-assigned and opaque. The engine must therefore maintain its own certificate numbering series and keep it stable, because the employee quotes it. COMPOSITE KEY - position breakdown. Because DIAN prescribes NO structure, the series is Mercans-designed and is fixed here so that it is stable and auditable: positions 1-4 = accrual year AAAA, source PayPeriod.Fiscal_Year, the year the income was earned and NOT the year of issue; position 5 = literal hyphen; positions 6-11 = a six-digit zero-filled consecutive, source Mercans.Certificate_Sequence, restarting at 000001 for each accrual year and unique per employer per year. PERSISTENCE: assigned once and NEVER reused, including after a reissue - a corrected certificate takes the NEXT consecutive and cites the superseded number, because ET art. 378 makes the employee's copy the evidential document and two certificates may not share a number.

edits.why: review language ('corrected', 'evidential') rephrased; rule unchanged

edits.current: Full corporate name (razon social) of the withholding agent, matching casilla 35 of the RUT; source Company.Legal_Name. Populated only for a legal person or sociedad de hecho. Do NOT copy the payroll organisation label printed in the title block of the client's payroll reports ('1764 - Compañía Colombiana de Tabaco SAS'): it prefixes the internal company code '1764 - ' and is not a reliable source of the RUT name. The same value feeds 'Payer or withholding agent name' on the signature line.

edits.current: The instruction guide prints a SIX-VALUE list on the form itself: 12 Minor ID card, 13 Citizenship ID card, 21 Tarjeta de extranjeria, 22 Foreign resident ID card, 31 NIT, 41 Passport. That is NARROWER than the electronic payroll list at Annex table 5.2.1, which also carries 11 Record civil, 42 Foreign identity document, 47 PEP, 50 NIT de otro pais and 91 NUIP. An employee holding a PEP or a PPT therefore has NO exact code here. SOURCE (client evidence): the client employee master holds NO document-type field. It holds one column per document - 'National ID', 'Identity Card', 'Indentity Card for Foreigners', 'Citizenship Card ID' - and 14 of 261 employees have two or three of them populated. The engine must store an explicit Employee.Document_Type for the document actually certified in casilla 25, not infer it from which column is filled. The mapping of the client columns to Form 220 codes must be confirmed with the client: 'Citizenship Card ID' -> 13 and 'Indentity Card for Foreigners' -> 22 are the evident candidates; 'National ID' and 'Identity Card' have no evident code (they appear next to a Citizenship Card for Colombian nationals).
edits.proposed: The instruction guide prints a SIX-VALUE list on the form itself: 12 Minor ID card, 13 Citizenship ID card, 21 Tarjeta de extranjeria, 22 Foreign resident ID card, 31 NIT, 41 Passport. That is NARROWER than the electronic payroll list at Annex table 5.2.1, which also carries 11 Record civil, 42 Foreign identity document, 47 PEP, 50 NIT de otro pais and 91 NUIP. An employee holding a PEP or a PPT therefore has NO exact code here. Rule to be set at implementation: the code to output for a PEP or PPT holder. SOURCE: the employee master holds one document-number field per document type ('National ID', 'Identity Card', 'Indentity Card for Foreigners', 'Citizenship Card ID') and no document-type field, and more than one of them may be populated for the same employee. The engine must store an explicit Employee.Document_Type for the document actually certified in casilla 25, never infer it from which field is filled. The mapping of the employee master document fields to the Form 220 codes is a configuration parameter supplied at implementation (e.g. 'Citizenship Card ID' -> 13 and 'Indentity Card for Foreigners' -> 22; 'National ID' and 'Identity Card' have no direct Form 220 code).
edits.why: client observation (client evidence, employee counts, 'confirmed with the client') rewritten as source mapping and configuration parameter

edits.current: Identification number exactly as it appears on the identity document of the type in casilla 24, held as text (no dots, hyphens or spaces). Join key to the electronic payroll NIE045, to PILA Record Tipo 2 campo 4 and to Format 2276 numeral 2. SOURCE: the document-number column of the employee master that matches casilla 24 ('Citizenship Card ID', 'Indentity Card for Foreigners', 'National ID' or 'Identity Card'). In the client's Accumulated Report the column 'EE Citizenship Card ID' carries the document number for 248 of 261 employees and is blank for most holders of a foreigner's card (13 blanks, all foreigner-card holders); it is not a complete source. Do NOT use the column 'ID Number' of the Accumulated Report or of the Base of Withholding: it is the internal employee number (equal to Master Data 'Employee ID' for 261 of 261 employees), not an identity document; both reports also end with footer rows ('GRAND TOTAL'; 'Confidential' in Master Data) that must be excluded. COVERAGE GAP: the Accumulated Report has 1,038 payees, of whom 777 (491 pension payees of 62154 and 286 others, 132 of them paid 62100 Ordinary Salary in September 2026) have no row in the employee master data report, so a document-number source is missing for them. For pension rows the client also records a separate payee ('Beneficiary National Id'), whose meaning (substitute pensioner or third-party payee) is not confirmed; see casilla 50. CLIENT EVIDENCE (tax-year-2025 Form 220 working table): for the 34 retirement-payment payees certified (wage types 62151 / 62152, none in the employee master, 26 of them in the round-1 Accumulated Report), casilla 25 equals the Accumulated Report column 'EE Citizenship Card ID' in 34 of 34 cases (the 'Beneficiary National Id' is blank on their rows); casillas 26-29 carry split names, which the Accumulated Report does not hold, so the client keeps an identity source for non-employee payees that has not been received and must be named (see Query to RA).
edits.proposed: Identification number exactly as it appears on the identity document of the type in casilla 24, held as text (no dots, hyphens or spaces). Join key to the electronic payroll NIE045, to PILA Record Tipo 2 campo 4 and to Format 2276 numeral 2. SOURCE: the document-number field of the employee master that matches the document type in casilla 24 ('Citizenship Card ID', 'Indentity Card for Foreigners', 'National ID' or 'Identity Card'), selected through Employee.Document_Type. Do NOT use the internal employee number ('Employee ID' / 'ID Number'): it is a payroll key, not an identity document. The casilla is mandatory: a blank document number is rejected as a data error. PAYEES OUTSIDE THE EMPLOYEE MASTER (pension payees and other non-employee payees): casilla 25 and the split names of casillas 26-29 are taken from the identity source configured at implementation for that payee population (a configuration parameter, e.g. the pensioner master), which must hold the document type, the document number and the four name parts. Where a pension is paid to a beneficiary other than the pensioner, see casilla 50.
edits.why: client observation (Accumulated Report, Base of Withholding, Master Data counts, coverage gap, tax-year-2025 working table, round 1, Query to RA) removed; identity of payees outside the employee master stated as a configured source

edits.current: First day of the certified period, output as AAAA MM DD. Normally 1 January of the tax year, but the start date of the employment relationship where the employee joined during the year. Bidirectional pair with casilla 31. SOURCE (to be confirmed with the client): the client employee master carries three start dates - 'Hire Date' and 'Original Hire Date' (format DD-MM-YYYY) and 'Adjusted Service Date' (format YYYY-MM-DD); 'Hire Date' differs from 'Original Hire Date' for 40 of 261 employees, where the original date points to earlier service (masked example: Hire Date 01-03-2026, Original Hire Date 27-02-2014). Use the start of the employment relationship current in the tax year (candidate: 'Hire Date') and convert the source format to AAAA MM DD.
edits.proposed: First day of the certified period, output as AAAA MM DD. Normally 1 January of the tax year, but the start date of the employment relationship where the employee joined during the year. Bidirectional pair with casilla 31. SOURCE: Master Data field 'Hire Date' (format DD-MM-YYYY, converted to AAAA MM DD) - the start of the employment relationship current in the tax year. The master-data date field used is a configuration parameter supplied at implementation (default 'Hire Date'); 'Original Hire Date' (DD-MM-YYYY) and 'Adjusted Service Date' (YYYY-MM-DD) refer to earlier or adjusted service and do not define the certified period.
edits.why: client observation ('to be confirmed with the client', 40 of 261, masked example) rewritten as source mapping and configuration parameter

edits.current: City or municipality where the withholding was practised - not necessarily the employer's registered domicile, and not necessarily the employee's place of work. It is a withholding-agent parameter (an employer setting), not an employee attribute: the client prints one fixed value, 'MEDELLIN' (upper case, no accents), on every row of its tax-year-2025 Form 220 working table, which pairs it with the DIVIPOLA code 05001 in the casilla-34 and casilla-35 columns. Output the municipality NAME that corresponds to the DANE code of casillas 34 and 35, so that the three casillas always describe the same place.
edits.proposed: City or municipality where the withholding was practised - not necessarily the employer's registered domicile, and not necessarily the employee's place of work. It is a withholding-agent parameter (an employer setting supplied at implementation, held as the five-digit DIVIPOLA code of the place of withholding), not an employee attribute. Output the municipality NAME, in upper case without accents, that corresponds to the DANE code of casillas 34 and 35, so that the three casillas always describe the same place.
edits.why: client observation (client's tax-year-2025 working table, 'MEDELLIN', 05001) removed; rule kept

edits.current: Total salary payments ACTUALLY MADE in the period to a resident natural person whose income derives from an employment or statutory relationship. The instruction guide quotes CST art. 127 in full: salary is not only the ordinary fixed or variable remuneration but everything the employee receives in money or in kind as direct consideration for the service - primas, sobresueldos, habitual bonuses, overtime, work on mandatory rest days, sales percentages and commissions. EXCLUSION RULE: do NOT include here any value belonging in casillas 38 to 46. CLIENT MAPPING: salary wage types evidenced in the client's accumulations include 62100 Ordinary Salary, 62101 Arrears - Ordinary salary, 62140 Integral Salary (the full integral salary, including the factor prestacional), 62141 Arrears-Integral Salary, 62118 Incentive Compensation - IC Local Country, 62133 Variable, 62208 March Bonus, 62209 Christmas Bonus, 62210 August Bonus, 62225 Salary Attendance Bonus-Monthly, 62228 Years of Service Bonus - CLA, 62113 Weekend payoff and 62841 / 62842 / 62845 overtime and night, Sunday or holiday surcharges. The client's 'Salary Payment Indicator' flag ('X', set on 30 wage types) must NOT be used as the casilla-36 rule on its own: it is also set on vacation pay (79401 Annual leave payout, 62116 Vacation Terminations, 62150 Vacation Bonus) and on per diems (62805-62808), which belong to casillas 42 and 43, and on the leave payouts 79405-79419 (marriage, maternity, paternity, sick-leave, bereavement, paid and jury leave payouts), whose casilla needs an RA decision; and it is absent from other bonuses (e.g. 62229 Years of Service Bonus NON CLA, 62224 Quarterly Salary Attendance Bonus, 62202 Ocassional Bonus Grossed Up). The engine needs an explicit wage-type-to-casilla table approved by the RA. Salary paid abroad to expatriates (25830 Salary paid in Foreign Countries, 65838 Incentive Compensation - IC-1001 Foreign Country) needs an RA decision. PERIOD: sum the payments made from 1 January to 31 December of the tax year; never a rolling 12-month total (the client's Accumulated Report 'Total' is a rolling 12-month total, October 2025 to September 2026).

EXCLUSION RULE: do NOT include here any value belonging in casillas 38 to 46. SOURCE: salary wage types 62100 Ordinary Salary, 62101 Arrears - Ordinary salary, 62140 Integral Salary (the full integral salary, including the factor prestacional), 62141 Arrears-Integral Salary, 62118 Incentive Compensation - IC Local Country, 62133 Variable, 62208 March Bonus, 62209 Christmas Bonus, 62210 August Bonus, 62225 Salary Attendance Bonus-Monthly, 62228 Years of Service Bonus - CLA, 62113 Weekend payoff and 62841 / 62842 / 62845 overtime and night, Sunday or holiday surcharges. The wage-type attribute 'Salary Payment Indicator' must NOT be used as the casilla-36 rule on its own: it is also set on vacation pay (79401 Annual leave payout, 62116 Vacation Terminations, 62150 Vacation Bonus) and on per diems (62805-62808), which belong to casillas 42 and 43, and on the leave payouts 79405-79419 (marriage, maternity, paternity, sick-leave, bereavement, paid and jury leave payouts); and it is absent from other bonuses (e.g. 62229 Years of Service Bonus NON CLA, 62224 Quarterly Salary Attendance Bonus, 62202 Ocassional Bonus Grossed Up). edits.current: Payments made in electronic or paper service vouchers, cheques, cards or vales - for fuel, school supplies, footwear and clothing, or any other purpose. Deductible for the employer and income for the employee. THREE EXPLICIT NOTES in the instruction guide: (1) INCLUDE meal payments for an employee earning MORE than 310 UVT per month; (2) do NOT include meal payments for an employee earning up to 310 UVT - those go to casilla 38; (3) do NOT include anything already reported in casilla 36. CLIENT EVIDENCE: the client books in-kind benefits paid to third parties as informative earning wage types ('Inf.') offset by an equal deduction - e.g. 65818 Meal Allowance Inf.-2079 offset by 21115 Meal Allowance Inf. Deduction-2644 (identical totals) - and the same pattern for 65811 Gym Allowance Inf.-6969, 65809 / 65839 Optical Allowance Inf, 65812 Text Books Allowance - Inf-6971, 65801 / 65814 / 65815 / 65831 Private Health Insurance Inf and 65817 / 65837 Life Insurance-Inf. Each must be assigned by the RA to casilla 37, 38 or 46 or to no casilla; the meal item 65818 is subject to the 41 UVT / 310 UVT test of casillas 37-38. The offsetting deduction wage types are payroll mechanics and are not themselves casilla values.

Deductible for the employer and income for the employee. THREE EXPLICIT NOTES in the instruction guide: (1) INCLUDE meal payments for an employee earning MORE than 310 UVT per month; (2) do NOT include meal payments for an employee earning up to 310 UVT - those go to casilla 38; (3) do NOT include anything already reported in casilla 36. SOURCE: in-kind benefits paid to third parties are booked as informative earning wage types ('Inf.') offset by an equal informative deduction - e.g. 65818 Meal Allowance Inf.-2079 offset by 21115 Meal Allowance Inf. Deduction-2644 - and the same pattern applies to 65811 Gym Allowance Inf.-6969, 65809 / 65839 Optical Allowance Inf, 65812 Text Books Allowance - Inf-6971, 65801 / 65814 / 65815 / 65831 Private Health Insurance Inf and 65817 / 65837 Life Insurance-Inf. The earning side is the certified value; the offsetting deduction wage types are payroll mechanics and are not themselves casilla values. The meal item 65818 is subject to the 41 UVT / 310 UVT test of casillas 37-38. Rule to be set at implementation: the casilla (37, 38, 46 or none) of each of the other in-kind benefit wage types listed above, in the wage-type-to-casilla table.
edits.why: client observation (CLIENT EVIDENCE, 'identical totals', RA assignment) rewritten as source mapping and one rule-to-be-set sentence

edits.current: Where the employer pays a THIRD PARTY for the employee's or their family's meals - a restaurant, own or third-party, or vouchers for food - the payment is deductible for the employer and is NOT income for the employee but for the supplier, PROVIDED the employee's salary does not exceed 310 UVT (COP 16,235,940 per month in 2026). Where the monthly payments exceed 41 UVT (COP 2,147,334 in 2026), THE EXCESS is taxable income of the employee and is withheld as employment income. The instruction guide adds that the rule does not apply to company representation expenses, which remain deductible. Do NOT include amounts already in casilla 36. CLIENT EVIDENCE: meal payments to third parties are wage type 65818 Meal Allowance Inf.-2079, available per employee per month (non-zero in all 12 months of the Accumulated Report). Run the test MONTH BY MONTH per employee: the month's meal payment against 41 UVT and the employee's monthly salary against 310 UVT, using the UVT parameter of the tax year (52,374 for 2026); do NOT read the UVT from the accumulated client wage type 58001 UVT, which is not always the UVT (it is doubled or altered in months with two payroll runs or retro runs). The casilla is the sum of the monthly excesses over the tax year.
edits.proposed: Where the employer pays a THIRD PARTY for the employee's or their family's meals - a restaurant, own or third-party, or vouchers for food - the payment is deductible for the employer and is NOT income for the employee but for the supplier, PROVIDED the employee's salary does not exceed 310 UVT (COP 16,235,940 per month in 2026). Where the monthly payments exceed 41 UVT (COP 2,147,334 in 2026), THE EXCESS is taxable income of the employee and is withheld as employment income. The instruction guide adds that the rule does not apply to company representation expenses, which remain deductible. Do NOT include amounts already in casilla 36. SOURCE: wage type 65818 Meal Allowance Inf.-2079, taken per employee per month. Run the test MONTH BY MONTH per employee: the month's meal payment against 41 UVT and the employee's monthly salary against 310 UVT, using the UVT parameter of the tax year (52,374 for 2026); do NOT read the UVT from wage type 58001 UVT, which is a per-run payroll amount and is multiplied in months with more than one payroll run or a retro run. The casilla is the sum of the monthly excesses over the tax year.
edits.why: client observation (CLIENT EVIDENCE, Accumulated Report, 'accumulated client wage type') rewritten as source mapping; rules kept

edits.current: Per diems paid to cover transport, subsistence and accommodation while the employee works away from the habitual place of work. The instruction guide cites Ministry of Labour Concept 23959 of 13 February. Note the split that matters elsewhere: the PERMANENT portion is salary under CST art. 130 and feeds the contribution base, while the accidental portion does not - the electronic payroll carries them as the paired ViaticoManuAlojS / NS elements. CLIENT MAPPING: wage types 62805 Hotel per diem, 62806 Breakfast per diem, 62807 Lunch per diem and 62808 Dinner per diem. The client flags them with 'Salary Payment Indicator' = X; they are still reported here and not in casilla 36, under the casilla-36 exclusion rule.
edits.proposed: Per diems paid to cover transport, subsistence and accommodation while the employee works away from the habitual place of work. SOURCE: wage types 62805 Hotel per diem, 62806 Breakfast per diem, 62807 Lunch per diem and 62808 Dinner per diem. These carry the 'Salary Payment Indicator' attribute; they are nonetheless reported here and not in casilla 36, under the casilla-36 exclusion rule.

edits.current: Work-income payments not falling in any other casilla. Use sparingly: DIAN expects a concept with a dedicated casilla to use that casilla. CLIENT EVIDENCE - earning wage types with no evident dedicated casilla, each needing an RA placement decision (casilla 36, 42, 46 or not certified): 62131 Scholarship-6861, 62700 School Allowance-6839, 62590 Marriage Allowance-6801, 62591 Child Birth Allowance-6002, 62112 Family Burial Allowance-6319, 62811 Health Allowance-6473, 62523 Transportation Allowance CLA- 2008, 62540 Housing Allowance Domestic Relocation-2087, 62310 Expat allowance 5526, 62320 Leasing Expat Allowance Inf-5524, 65821 Expatriation Package for Inbounds, 65800 Stock awards (Vesting) - Informative-1004, 62138 Dividend payment (stock awards) -1003, 65803 Plan Institucional PROTECCION - Payment- 6785, 65804 Plan Institucional PROTECCION - IC Bonus, 62180 / 62181 Severance/Layoff Payment (dismissal indemnity) and 62837 Leave payout. The engine must hold an explicit wage-type-to-casilla table; no earning wage type may be left unassigned. CLIENT PRACTICE (tax-year-2025 Form 220 working table): the client certifies the whole income of its 34 retirement-payment payees (62151 Retirement Payment - PRV-6795 and 62152 Retirement Payment - Catleya-6796) in casilla 46 'Otros pagos', with casilla 50 = 0. This conflicts with the casilla-50 treatment if the RA classifies these wage types as pension income - see the Query to RA of casilla 50. Do not adopt either placement until the RA answers.

edits.current: THE FIRST OF THREE SEVERANCE LINES. Severance savings and the interest on them ACTUALLY PAID to the employee in the period - typically the January interest payment and any authorised partial withdrawal or termination settlement. Excluded from the monthly withholding base under ET art. 206 num. 4 but still certified here. CLIENT MAPPING: 62110 Cash-out of Severance Pay - Social Benefits -541S and 62117 Cash-out of Interest Severance Pay - Social Benefits-541R (termination and settlement payments, present in most months), 62126 Advance Severance Last Year (partial payments, mainly January and March 2026) and 62127 Advance Interest Severance Pay (the annual interest on severance, paid in January: COP 269.0 million in the 01/01/2026 column). Provision wage types (22110, 22112, 42110, 42112) and balance wage types (63814, 63815, 64999, 68028) are accruals or balances, not payments, and are not certified here.

edits.current: THE THIRD OF THREE SEVERANCE LINES. The amount DEPOSITED to the employee's chosen severance fund by 14 February for the balance at the preceding 31 December, under Ley 50 de 1990 art. 99. The engine must maintain all three buckets - paid to the employee, traditional regime, deposited to the fund - separately from the outset; they cannot be split retrospectively out of a single cesantias figure. CLIENT MAPPING: wage type 25827 Payment Severance Funds Inf. (mirrored by 65805 with the same amount - take one, not both), paid in February (COP 2,064.8 million in the 01/02/2026 column). The tax year in which a February deposit (for the balance at the preceding 31 December) is certified is an open point for the RA - see Query to RA. The provision wage types 22110 / 42110 are accruals, not the deposit.
